tagline: Personalised greeting cards for the people and moments that matter

routes.label: M-PESA app
steps: Open the M-PESA app and tap Pay.

routes.label: SIM toolkit
steps: Open M-PESA on your SIM menu and select Lipa na M-PESA.
Enter your M-PESA PIN and confirm.

routes.label: Dial *334#
steps: Select Send to Pochi La Biashara.
Enter your M-PESA PIN and confirm.

notes: Pochi La Biashara payments have no account-number field, so share your order reference with us on WhatsApp or enter your M-PESA confirmation code on your order page.
Standard M-PESA transaction charges set by Safaricom apply to the sender.
We check every payment by hand against our M-PESA statement. Your order stays "payment being verified" until we have confirmed it.

formats.description: PNG image, 1200 × 1800 px. Sent to you on WhatsApp, or downloadable from your order page once payment is confirmed.
